title: Worth held close by grace
subtitle: A short return when dignity has been outsourced
description: A brief path that brings worth back from response, status, and success into the nearness of the Lord who holds the humble close.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The humble servant is cherished by the Lord; nearness is not awarded by status.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let being held close matter more than being ranked high.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle returns dignity to grace and belonging.
evidence.turn: Worth steadies when it is received from nearness, not borrowed from applause.
evidence.practicalImplication: Refuse one status-check and take one humble step under grace.
